## ThornixOS fleet health

Checks the internal service tier every five minutes. A failure must appear twice before Herald is notified; recovery is reported immediately. Identical states are deduplicated.

Before publishing, select the **Herald ntfy publisher** Bearer Auth credential on the final node. The workflow imports inactive and contains no token.
